title: A fictional burst and drain cycle
method: Start empty. Burst arrivals 120/s minus processing 100/s for 300 s yields 6,000 events. Then processing 100/s minus arrivals 60/s drains 6,000 in 150 s. Constant rates, no failures, no expiry, no partition skew.
alt: A fictional burst and drain cycle. Start: 0 queued events; After 300-second burst: 6000 queued events; After 150-second drain: 0 queued events. Illustrative inputs.
